apps.description: The Academy's maintained build of KisMac: passive Wi-Fi scanning, hidden-SSID detection, client mapping, and GPS/KML export, remediated and rebuilt for macOS High Sierra. For network education and authorized testing of your own networks only. Installs as KisMac2.app (bundle identity com.igrsoft.kismac) — a bundle identity distinct from the Switchboard entry, whose corrected staged-v1-2 build ships as Workbench.app under its own identity; the two now install side by side.
apps.name: KisMac
apps.tagline: Wireless network discovery for education and authorized testing.

apps.description: The Academy's maintained build of Spectacle, the keyboard-driven window manager. The inherited Sparkle 1.22/DSA update channel is replaced under the Academy Update Infrastructure Standard (Sparkle 2.9.6, EdDSA, Academy appcast) at packaging.
apps.name: Spectacle
apps.tagline: Move and resize windows with the keyboard, maintained for High Sierra.

apps.description: The Academy's maintained build of MacDown. Uplift includes the Hoedown recursion-bound fix and the planned migration from legacy WebView to WKWebView; zero telemetry, MathJax bundled locally.
apps.name: MacDown
apps.tagline: Markdown editor with live preview, maintained for High Sierra.

apps.description: The Academy's maintained build of Sequel Pro. Passwords stay in the macOS Keychain, as upstream correctly designed; the uplift addresses the MySQL 8 authentication gap left by the bundled MySQL 5.5-era client library.
apps.name: Sequel Pro
apps.tagline: MySQL database client, maintained for High Sierra.

apps.description: An Academy combine-fork: an Audacity-derived editor (pinned Audacity 3.7.9, the last line supporting macOS 10.13) with libVLC (pinned VLC 3.0.24) in a separate helper process for playback, conversion, and video-companion duties. Differentiators: High Sierra floor and a zero-telemetry build, verified by network capture before publication. Ships GPL-3.0 with full source, per the Gate 0 license record. Fork pending; sourceURL is set when the org repo is created.
apps.name: SoundDeck
apps.tagline: Audio editor with VLC-powered playback and conversion — in development.

apps.description: Staged internal build of the Academy's unified network utility (working name Switchboard), CI-built 2026-11-08 and not yet verified on the High Sierra rig: the remediated KisMac discovery engine hosted in a new unified shell, a read-only AirPort base-station configuration view, Ping / Netstat / Traceroute / Speed Test diagnostics, and a local-only journal. Manage is read-only in this build — there is no configuration write path. The AirPort management pillar also ships as KisMac V2; Switchboard remains the umbrella product and the parity source of truth. Installs as Workbench.app under its own bundle identity (com.detroitautomationacademy.workbench), distinct from KisMac — bundle-collision correction (2026-11-08): this staged-v1-2 build and the KisMac entry now install side by side. The earlier staged-v1-1 build shared the KisMac bundle identity and installing one replaced the other.
apps.name: Switchboard
apps.tagline: One network utility: discovery, diagnostics, and read-only base-station view — staged test build.

apps.description: The Academy's native macOS edition of Live Transit Detroit: the whole regional network (DDOT, SMART, QLINE, People Mover) as one live map and vehicle list, rendered in native Core Graphics with no WebView or browser engine. Static route geometry ships in the bundle; only the small live vehicle feed is fetched, on a conditional-GET refresh.
apps.name: Live Transit Detroit
apps.tagline: Live regional transit for the District of Detroit — native, no browser, built for High Sierra.

apps.description: Distro is the Detroit Automation Academy's native application-store app for macOS High Sierra: it browses the Academy catalog, downloads Academy-maintained apps from the AutomatedTechnologies GitHub org, verifies every download by SHA-256 before install, and carries no privileged helper. Prepared at DAADV3 T1 codification (2026-11-07); not yet published — publication remains gated on Distro tranche D-T5. Disassembled. Scanned. Recompiled. Distro distributes only apps carrying the Academy audit entry in their plist — proof of the Academy pipeline.
apps.name: Distro
apps.tagline: The Academy's application store for High Sierra — browse, install, and update Academy apps.

apps.description: The Academy's build of the open-source muse-desktop client (MIT, v0.3.0) on Electron 22.3.27 — the last Electron that runs on macOS 10.13 — so Intel High Sierra machines can run a Muse client at all; the official Muse app requires Apple Silicon and a current macOS. Packaged with the Academy monochrome icon. Unofficial build: not a Meta product and not endorsed by Meta. Unsigned test build; it has not yet been launched on the Academy's High Sierra rig — that first launch is the pending verification gate.
apps.name: Muse (Academy Build)
apps.tagline: The Muse desktop client, rebuilt by the Academy for High Sierra.
